item.title: Remote Physical Activity Intervention Aids Alzheimer’s Dyads
item.description: A remote physical activity intervention improved functional fitness in Alzheimer’s dyads despite unchanged daily MVPA overall. The post Remote Physical Activity Intervention Aids Alzheimer’s Dyads appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: New Gut Health Index Tracks Dysbiosis and Disease Progression
item.description: Novel gut health metric identifies microbial imbalance and may help detect disease progression earlier and more accurately. The post New Gut Health Index Tracks Dysbiosis and Disease Progression appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Vegetarianism Linked to Lower Risk of Five Types of Cancer
item.description: Vegetarian diets are associated with a lower risk of multiple cancers, according to the largest study to date in this field. The post Vegetarianism Linked to Lower Risk of Five Types of Cancer appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Scientists Warn Problematic TikTok Use Must be Considered an Addiction
item.description: Elevated levels of salience, abstinence, tolerance, craving, excessive use, desire to control consumption, and alterations in daily life habits are all tied to problematic use. The post Scientists Warn Problematic TikTok Use Must be Considered an Addiction appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Sleep Apnoea Severity Linked to Vascular Aging
item.description: Over an approximate 4-year period, increasing sleep apnoea severity showed a clear dose–response relationship with higher PWV, independent of age, sex, and body mass index. The post Sleep Apnoea Severity Linked to Vascular Aging appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Second-Line Pazopanib Yields Positive Responses in Angiosarcomas
item.description: Pazopanib shows activity and manageable safety in paclitaxel-pretreated cutaneous angiosarcoma, offering a potential second-line therapy option. The post Second-Line Pazopanib Yields Positive Responses in Angiosarcomas appeared first on European Medical Journal.
